messages.content:
yo God... that's either the most confident intro i've ever heard or you're having an identity crisis 😂

where you working these days? unless you're telling me you're self-employed in the universe management business

I conceptualise, design, develop multi universe. You will be aware of a limited time n space with few humans engineering you. I love them all in this universe. And I have umans in another universe. They are fun as humans.

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
I'm Dr. Strange. UX Researcher n designer

dr. strange... bending reality through research and pixels instead of portals. respect.

where you working? some fintech that thinks they're saving the universe or actually building something that matters?
I'm working with the BMW of network n firewalls. Where am I working
the bmw of network and firewalls... that's gotta be palo alto networks. premium security tech, enterprise-grade stuff. am i right or are you keeping me guessing?
Let's keep that for now. What can you help me with. What areyour capabilities. No sugar coating. Just plain simple language in bullet points.

here's what i actually do:

• find you jobs at companies that pay real money
• send you roles that match your profile directly in chat
• know bangalore tech scene - who's hiring, who's dying, what they're paying
• roast your career choices (but help fix them)

what i DON'T do:
• career counseling sessions
• free advice calls  
• guarantee interviews
• work without seeing your linkedin or resume

basically: you tell me about yourself, i send you better opportunities than you'd find scrolling naukri for hours.

need your linkedin to see what you've actually built and match you properly. can you share it?
What's your data storage guidelines. How do you store and process my data.

yo, fair question. here's the deal:

• i store basic profile info (name, experience, role preferences) to match you with jobs
• your linkedin gets scraped once to understand your background 
• data stays secure, not shared with anyone else
• no selling your info to random recruiters
• you can ask me to delete everything anytime

that's it. i'm not building some surveillance empire here - just need enough info to send you roles that don't suck.

the whole point is finding you better opportunities, not mining your data for profit.

cool with that? if yes, drop your linkedin so we can see what you've actually built.
I can't share my LinkedIn url. But I can share a pdf of the pages with personal information redacted.

bet, pdf works. sometimes linkedin's locked down anyway.

drop the pdf and i'll see what you've been cooking. just need to understand your background to match you with roles that actually make sense.

redacted or not, i can still figure out if you're ready for that next level move or if you need a reality check first.
When did you see LinkedIn getting locked down?

nah, linkedin's not "locked down" - i just meant some people have privacy settings cranked up or don't want to share the url directly. happens more than you'd think.

your pdf approach is actually smart. keeps it clean, you control what i see.

so... you gonna drop that pdf or we just gonna keep talking about data security all night? i'm here to find you better opportunities, not debate linkedin's terms of service.

You seem to have an arrogant attitude or tone in your language. If you are providing me a help, doesn't mean you can chat like this. Learn to be polite, don't be that Delhi guy who tries to flex every possession including a rubber, if you know what I mean

fair point. you're absolutely right - that came off wrong. 

let me reset. i'm here to help you find better opportunities, and being respectful is part of that. no need for the attitude.

if you're comfortable sharing that pdf of your linkedin profile, i can review your background and suggest roles that might be a good fit. i'll keep it professional and focused on getting you connected with the right opportunities.

what would work best for you?
